preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between n-1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range 1 to n.
The number of edges provided matches the given m.

postconditions.description: The result is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.
The result is the integer x such that 0 ≤ x < 10^9 + 7 and x ⋅ q ≡ p (mod 10^9 + 7), where p/q is the variance of the number of connected components in the remaining graph.
